Name: Sheshai, Son of Anak
Summary: Sheshai, son of Anak, was one of the Anakim the spies saw dwelling in Hebron.
KeyStory: The spies found Sheshai in Hebron and carried home a report of giants that melted Israel's courage.
RelatedPeople: Anak; Ahiman, Son of Anak; Talmai, Son of Anak; Caleb
LifeLesson: A fearful report can undo a whole people; a faithful one can steady them.
